import pandas as pd

def main():
    # File paths for the source CSV files
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_66/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_66/test_1.csv"
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_66/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load Source 0
    # Schema: ['State', 'Participation', 'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing', 'Math', 'Total']
    df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, dtype={
        'State': str,
        'Participation': str,
        'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing': int,
        'Math': int,
        'Total': int
    })

    # Load Source 1
    # Schema: ['State', 'Participation', 'English', 'Math', 'Reading', 'Science', 'Composite']
    df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, dtype={
        'State': str,
        'Participation': str,
        'English': float,
        'Math': float,
        'Reading': float,
        'Science': float,
        'Composite': float
    })

    # Rename columns in df0 to match target schema suffixes (_x)
    df0_renamed = df0.rename(columns={
        'Participation': 'Participation_x',
        'Math': 'Math_x'
    })

    # Rename columns in df1 to match target schema suffixes (_y)
    df1_renamed = df1.rename(columns={
        'Participation': 'Participation_y',
        'Math': 'Math_y'
    })

    # Merge on 'State' column
    # Both sources have 'State' as string and should match exactly
    merged = pd.merge(df0_renamed, df1_renamed, on='State', how='inner', validate='one_to_one')

    # Select and reorder columns to match target schema:
    # ['State': string,
    #  'Participation_x': string,
    #  'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing': integer,
    #  'Math_x': integer,
    #  'Total': integer,
    #  'Participation_y': string,
    #  'English': float,
    #  'Math_y': float,
    #  'Reading': float,
    #  'Science': float,
    #  'Composite': float]

    target_columns = [
        'State',
        'Participation_x',
        'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing',
        'Math_x',
        'Total',
        'Participation_y',
        'English',
        'Math_y',
        'Reading',
        'Science',
        'Composite'
    ]

    # Ensure all target columns exist after merge
    missing_cols = set(target_columns) - set(merged.columns)
    if missing_cols:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing columns after merge: {missing_cols}")

    target_df = merged[target_columns]

    # Save to CSV without index
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
